notes.title: Update on The Green Book: What’s Next?
notes.notes:
Hello, Green Book Community!

We wanted to share an important update with you all. Unfortunately, our recent Kickstarter campaign didn’t reach its funding goal. While this was a tough outcome, we’re incredibly grateful for the support and enthusiasm we received from our amazing community. Your belief in The Green Book has been truly inspiring.

[b]What’s Next for The Green Book?[/b]

We’re not giving up on our vision. We remain fully committed to bringing The Green Book to life and are currently exploring different ways to make it happen. This project is close to our hearts, and with your continued support, we know we can achieve something truly special.

[b]Stay Connected[/b]

If you’d like to stay updated on our progress, please consider joining our Discord server or following us on social media. We’ll be sharing updates, sneak peeks, and more as we move forward.

Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/Tj5UhBvPdR]discord.gg/Tj5UhBvPdR[/url]
Twitter: [url=https://x.com/tapteek]x.com/tapteek[/url]

Thank you for being part of this journey with us. Your support means everything, and we can’t wait to share what’s next for The Green Book with you. 🪴💚
